description: Hi, I'm Antoni, an 16-year-old developer from Poland. I run a small web design business and built my own health app that pulls wearable data from Google Health (Fitbit) into a Whoop-style journal tracking how habits affect sleep and recovery. Here I'm adapting it for astronauts: log health data, spot what hurts recovery, and get clear recommendations without mission control. Skills: web development, UI/UX, wearable data, AI-assisted coding. Not looking for team members right now.
